Name: Small Bottle
Description: A small bottle of your own beer. Pour it on a player for one surprise ability until the final whistle: good when he attacks, bad when he defends. Fills the drunk meter by 10%.

Name: Large Bottle
Description: A large bottle of your own beer. Pour it on a player for one surprise ability until the final whistle: good when he attacks, bad when he defends. Fills the drunk meter by 20%.

Name: Kleiner Faß
Description: A small keg of your own beer. Pour it on a player for one surprise ability until the final whistle: good when he attacks, bad when he defends. Fills the drunk meter by 35%.

Name: Anstoß Helles
